variables.name: passes_timestep_filter
variables.meaning: The candidate point passes the requested timestep cutoff.

time_model.description: Each step observes timestep-filter eligibility for an arbitrary result point in a plot_results call; no walltime bound is introduced.

explanation.text:
SCOPE: in the interval defined by the entire execution.
TRIGGER: first point in the interval.
REQUIRED BEHAVIOR: for every trigger, (( ! cutoff_supplied => passes_timestep_filter )) must hold at all time points between (and including) the trigger and the end of the interval.
